0: Tracked prey through old growth. Took the timber on the way.
The forest here is both dense and loud.
Cleared a path. Something followed the noise.
Scent trail and wood grain both pointing the same direction.
Canopy thick enough to swallow sound. Worked quietly.
Cut a tree. Heard a snarl. The two things were not unrelated.
Followed prey into a stand worth felling. Did both.
Quarry knew the forest. The forest now knows me a little.
Walked between scent and bark all morning. Both were leading.
Old trails left by hooves and by axes. Same forest, two paths through it.

light: Axe swing flushed something out. Not what I wanted.
The quarry circled while I was working the tree.
Tangled branches and pursuit. Sorted it out.
Sapling whipped back into the face. Lost the scent for a moment.
Cut a branch. The thing under the branch ran. Did not catch it.
Bramble caught the bag while the quarry got loose. Brief setback.
Tracked prey to a tree I had to cut to keep tracking. Inefficient.
Quarry watched from the canopy while I worked. Knew it was being watched.
moderate: Prey doubled back through the work site.
Pack found me while I had my back to the trees.
Falling tree drew everything within hearing. Sorted them after.
Quarry came at me through the brush I had just cleared. Convenient for it.
Cut the wrong tree to reveal the wrong thing. Adapted.
Boar in the work site. The work and the boar disagreed.
Tracked into a clearing already occupied. Negotiated.
severe: Mob and prey converged at once. Ran.
The falling tree scattered both of us.
Too much happening in the same clearing. Got out.
Pack came through the cut I had just made. Made another cut.
Tree fell on what I had been hunting. The kill counted, technically.
Quarry led me into a place I had not cleared. Cleared it in a hurry.
Stampede through the felling area. Lost the day's wood. Found it later.
Three things wrong at once, all of them with teeth. Came back with the work.
